resources.string: Tap the bubble that appears above your keyboard, talk, tap again. Your words are turned into text on the phone, tidied up by Claude, and typed into the box.

Shows a microphone bubble while your keyboard is open and types what you say into the text box you are using. It only watches for the keyboard opening and closing and which text box is selected. It does not read the screen.
